div.p: This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

ul.li: Import all the codes that are contained in Medical Reason Not Done SCT
Import all the codes that are contained in Patient Reason Not Done SCT
Import all the codes that are contained in System Reason

publisher.value: Office of the National Coordinator for Health Information Technology (ONC)

name.value: Office of the National Coordinator for Health Information Technology (ONC)

description.value: This value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate the reason an action was not taken

purpose.value: This value set was defined to support identifying any of the possible negation reason codes as part of USQualityCore profiles. The value set is composed of the codes from [Medical Reason Not Done SCT](http://cts.nlm.nih.gov/fhir/ValueSet/2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1021.56), [Patient Reason Not Done SCT](http://cts.nlm.nih.gov/fhir/ValueSet/2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1021.58), and [System Reason](http://cts.nlm.nih.gov/fhir/ValueSet/2.16.840.1.113883.3.526.3.1009) as defined and available in the Value Set Authority Center.
